messages:
incident-bot: P1 - Elevated 5xx+gateway errors noticed for /v1/generate (hosted). Alerting oncall.

alex: paging sam (oncall) - we're seeing a 3x spike in 5xx and timeouts across multiple regions, error class: gateway_timeout / upstream_5xx

sam: on it. looking at metrics -> grafana link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/alert/kv-prefix-5xx

sam: initial look - error spike corresponds to a sharp drop in successful cache hits on prefix-KV layer. KV miss rate jumped from 2% -> 45% starting 13:12 UTC

alex: logs show repeated "KV prefix checksum mismatch" on a handful of nodes:
```
2026-03-14T13:12:39Z WARN kv-prefix: checksum mismatch prefix=abc123 node=gw-12
2026-03-14T13:12:39Z ERROR router: upstream 502 from runtime-gw-12
```

tara: curious if this is metadata corruption after recent rollout. Any config changes in last 48h?

jon: deploy history: quantization rollout to dedicated pools yesterday evening; no KV schema changes. Runtime had a package bump at 02:10 UTC today (commit c3f9a).

sam: ok - potential correlation but not conclusive. Mitigation plan: disable prefix-memoization on the runtime as a quick toggle, then clear KV prefix caches on suspected nodes.

eric: I can run cache clear on gw-12/gw-13/gw-14. Which command do you want? runbook suggests `curl -XPOST http://<gw>/admin/cache/clear?prefix=kv-prefix`

sam: execute on gw-12 first and watch. Also enable fallback routing to model-variant-fallback (lower perf but no prefix reliance):
```
POST /admin/routing
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "policy": "fallback-model-variant" }
```

alex: notifying product/support: customers may see 502/504 for hosted API. CS to triage tickets and escalate. Assigning Linda.

linda: on it. Posting notice to status.redwood.ai draft: "We are investigating elevated 5xx in hosted API affecting some customers. Mitigation in progress."

incident-bot: @pagerduty incident created PD-5621 severity=P1, incident channel #incidents engaged, pager dispatched to sam and tara.

sam: cleared prefix cache on gw-12. immediate drop in 5xx on that node. Hit rate improved from 0.2 -> 0.86. Continuing sequential clears.

eric: cleared gw-13,gw-14. aggregate 5xx back down to baseline ~1.1% after traffic shifted to fallback rules.

jon: ran a health check across runtime pool; found inconsistent KV checksum versions between older nodes and recent rollout group. suspect rollout left mixed-state.

tara: temporarily pausing autoscaler and blocking further rollout until root cause is known. Also marking the rollout for rollback tomorrow if suspected.

alex: customer impact: high for a subset of hosted customers using longer prefix sequences and high-concurrency; observed timeouts for some streaming calls. No data loss reported. Severity P1.

linda: status page published. CS alerted top 10 customers by volume. No public incident update yet — wait for mitigation confirmation.

sam: next steps:
- continue cache clears on any nodes with checksum mismatch
- roll traffic to fallback model-variant and keep until next maintenance
- collect KV dumps from affected nodes for postmortem
- prepare rollback plan for runtime package c3f9a

eric: capturing logs and KV checksums: /var/log/kv-prefix-dump-1805004321.tgz

jon: tagging this as likely cause: prefix cache corruption triggered by mixed-version rollout -> eviction storm and cascading timeouts.

tara: handoff to oncall-night (tara -> jon at 20:00 UTC). Jon will keep monitors and coordinate postmortem.

jon: taking over for night. leaving runbook steps executed in thread. ping me directly if 5xx > 2% again.

alex: thanks team. postmortem owner: sam. we should include timeline, root cause hypothesis, and action items: atomic rollout gating, stronger checksum mismatch detection, and safer cache migration APIs.

linda: will update customers and close PD once metrics stable for 2 hours.

incident-bot: Incident PD-5621 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closed? pending.
